meta.value_rule: families: v_i=(i+1) (ramp) and v_i=frac((i+1)·φ)·100 (golden-ratio scatter); I1: S(10v)=10S(v); I2: S(v+c·1)=S(v)+c·Σq with c=7; I3: shipped pick == argmax(surface distribution, ties→first); I4: |Σq−1| vs the ±1e-3 wire budget (measured, disclosed).
meta.gate_rules: CONTROL gates (a red refuses the run): I1/I2 residual ≤ 1e-9 at every surface; I3 ZERO argmax disagreements at every surface (engine-raw, engine-norm, wire-round6 — each SELF-consistent, never cross-compared); I4 ≤ 1e-3. Route agreement is characterization (no bar).
